title: Target Shoplifter Breaks Down After $1,200 Clothing Heist Fails
description:
On October 22nd, 2024. Police responded to Target about a 36-year-old woman who got caught shoplifting Over $1200 worth of items. According to the loss prevention officer, the woman only paid for $50 of her items and tried concealing the rest and then walked out of the store. The is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
